title: Quaternion Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Kinematics
description: Choose an axis and an angle and read the four numbers of the unit quaternion for that turn, with a picture of the half angle that the formula uses. Then calculate quaternion components, turn angles and SLERP angles in six problems. Used in Chapter 19.

educational.topic: Unit quaternions, the half angle, and SLERP
learningObjectives: Calculate quaternion components, turn angles and SLERP angles from given rotations, to within 0.1 of the unit shown, in six problems, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: See the half angle in a picture, then use a few formulas on new numbers with an immediate check
keyQuestions: Why is w the cosine of half the angle and not of the whole angle?
What angle lies between two rotations whose quaternions have a dot product of 0.5?
commonMisconceptions: The w of a quaternion is the cosine of the full angle
SLERP at one quarter of the way is a quarter of the numbers
The angle between two rotations is the arccosine of the dot product
assessmentOpportunities: Six typed answers, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery
